title: Give every feature that owns WMBTs source code under its feature directory

facts.note: Plan files and feature source dirs are path-matchable; roots resolved from the topology settings.

values: WMBT added to or moved between features
facts.note: Needs a diff observer linking plan WMBT ownership to source presence per feature.

values: atdd_topology: feature owns WMBTs but has no source component
facts.note: The atdd_topology validator emits the finding; it must be surfaced as an activation fact.

fires: A feature in the plan owns one or more WMBTs and `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` holds no source component.
A change deletes or moves the last source component out of a feature directory whose feature still owns WMBTs.
The only source for a WMBT-owning feature sits in `node_modules`, `dist`, `build` or `_generated` beneath it.
doesNotFire: A feature that owns no WMBTs has no source directory.
A WMBT-owning feature has at least one source component beneath its feature directory.
Changes confined to vendored or generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`).

given: A feature in the plan owns WMBTs (behaviour to deliver).
when: The topology gate checks `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` for that feature.
then: At least one source component exists beneath `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` for every feature that owns WMBTs.
prefer: Implement the feature beneath its own feature directory.
If another feature actually delivers the behaviour, move the WMBTs to that feature in the plan.
avoid: Leaving a WMBT-owning feature with no implementation (a gap the plan already names).
Satisfying the check with source placed only in vendored or generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`); those are never scanned.
why: A feature with behaviour to deliver and no implementation is a gap the plan already names.
evidence: The atdd_topology validator reports no feature that owns WMBTs without a source component beneath `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/`.
The rule's failing fixture (a WMBT-owning feature with no source) is rejected by the guard.
verifier_detail: For each feature owning >=1 WMBT, require >=1 source component under `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/`.
audit: Package rule of atdd-bun (term package_rule); statement: 'Package rule, strict.'

sharedNodes.text: package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.

additions.text: The rule's failing fixture is rejected by the guard.
additions.justification: Derived from the package_rule term (every package rule has a failing fixture); makes compliance verification concrete.
Required by the target structure; derived directly from the statement and the exception.
